scope: Synthetic personalized normal/danger initialization for TYPE_2 only
personalization_method: Per-patient care plan and risk-stratified ADA CGM time goals; glucose cut points remain standardized because the guideline does not support unique cut points.
not_used_as_risk_inputs: creatinine without a recorded renal diagnosis or validated eGFR
medication_data_caveat: NHANES medication records are self-reported baseline prescriptions; dose, schedule, current active status, and hypoglycemia history are unavailable. Medication exposure therefore increases review sensitivity but does not change ADA glucose cut points.
safety_note: All approvals and identities are synthetic demo records. Values are ADA-derived reference targets and must not be used for real patient care without clinician review.
